newhere.heading: Get involved
newhere.body: Meetings, actions and committees are open to everyone. Come find your place in the work.

steps.title: Become a member
steps.body: Sign up in a few minutes. Dues are sliding-scale — pay what you can, and no one is turned away for lack of funds.

steps.title: Come to Progress Now 101
steps.body: Our intro session for new and curious folks — what we stand for, what our chapter is working on, and how to plug in. Offered virtually and in person, multiple times a month. You don't have to be a member yet to attend.

steps.title: Get onboarded & plug in
steps.body: After 101, we'll add you to our WhatsApp and match you with a committee that fits your interests and capacity — whether that's an hour a month or a night a week.

committees.heading: Committees
committees.intro: Committees are where the work happens. Each one meets regularly and welcomes new members — reach out through the WhatsApp or at any general meeting.

items.label: WhatsApp
items.desc: Our main channel — members receive an invite during onboarding

items.question: Do I have to be a member to come to events?
items.answer: Nope — most of our events are open to everyone. Come to a 101 or a social, meet folks, and see if it's for you. No pressure.

items.question: How much are dues?
items.answer: Dues are sliding-scale — most folks pay a few dollars a month. If dues are a barrier, talk to us: no one is turned away for lack of funds.

items.question: I've never done anything political before. Is that okay?
items.answer: More than okay — it's the norm. Most members joined without any organizing experience. Progress Now 101 exists exactly for this, and committees will teach you everything as you go.

items.question: Can I participate without being publicly visible?
items.answer: Yes. There are plenty of ways to contribute behind the scenes, and we take members' privacy and safety seriously. Talk to us about what you're comfortable with.

items.question: How much time does membership take?
items.answer: As much or as little as you have. Some members show up to one event a month; others help lead committees. Capacity changes — that's fine. The work is a marathon, not a sprint.

card.heading: Ready right now?
card.body: Membership takes five minutes, and dues are pay-what-you-can.
